import React from 'react'; export default function MarkerRoleWarningModal({ markerRole, attemptedAction, onClose }) { return (
⚠️ Role Restriction
You are assigned to mark papers as:
{markerRole}
But you are attempting to mark as:
{attemptedAction}

This action is not allowed. Please contact your department administrator if you need your role to be changed.

); }
